nodes.name: setup_telemetry
nodes.description: Configures OpenTelemetry environment variables for Claude Code. Detects the project name from git remote/toplevel/PWD. Exports OTEL exporters, endpoint, protocol, and metric interval. New in this revision: auto-generates OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS (BasicAuth) from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CREDENTIALS (user:password format) via base64 encoding, only when credentials are set and headers are not already configured.

nodes.name: print_telemetry_status
nodes.description: Prints a one-line telemetry status message to stdout showing endpoint, project name extracted from OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES, and protocol. No-ops if CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY is not 1.

nodes.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CREDENTIALS
nodes.description: Input variable (user:password format). When set and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS is not already configured, setup_telemetry base64-encodes this value and exports it as an Authorization=Basic header in OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.

nodes.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
nodes.description: Output variable set by setup_telemetry. Contains BasicAuth Authorization header derived from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CREDENTIALS. Not overwritten if already set by caller.

nodes.name: otel.sh
nodes.description: Telemetry module for iclaude. Sources setup_telemetry on load. Provides BasicAuth header auto-generation from OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_CREDENTIALS, project name detection from git, and OTEL exporter configuration. Designed to be sourced from the iclaude entry-point scripts.
